notes: Text extracted with pymupdf; figures not visible. Drop clause probability p is the swept variable (0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75) within each config group; it is not a tm_config field. Clause counts are as printed (e.g. 'we use 10,000 clauses'); the paper never says whether they are per class or total (Sec. 3.1 only says p=0.75 'is equivalent of dropping 75% of the total clauses per class'), so clauses_scope is not_reported. Implementation is 'custom' (drop clause written in PyCUDA, Sec. 3); the library is not named. CTM weighting is inferred from 'top k weighted clauses' (Sec. 4.2, Fig. 3). Statistic: only the best-p image results (and Kuzushiji-MNIST) are stated as means over 100 runs; the text calls them 'Peak accuracy ... averaged over 100 runs', so it is unclear whether each run's value is the peak over epochs; other TM rows give no averaging. There is no validation set; the best p per dataset is chosen from the test results shown (Tables 1/5), so selection_on_test is not_reported for the TM rows rather than false. Epoch count is never stated. Not in the record (omission, not an error): NLP inference time '< 2.3 ms per sample on average on an NVIDIA RTX 3070 8GB GPU' (Sec. 3.1, p. 4); Table 2/3/6/7 TM columns duplicate Table 1/5 values. Code footnote says github without a URL.
